name: Check MCP Server
description: Runs payroll from AI clients on Check's payroll API: manages companies, employees, contractors, payrolls, taxes and payments through a hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Run Payroll
skills.description: Creates payrolls, adds earnings and deductions, previews totals and approves payroll runs through the Check API.

skills.name: Manage Employees and Contractors
skills.description: Creates, updates and views employees and 1099 contractors, including onboarding status and tax forms.

skills.name: Manage Payroll Taxes
skills.description: Views and updates W-4 elections, state withholding, tax filings and exemptions for employees and companies.

skills.name: Payroll Reports
skills.description: Generates payroll journals, tax summaries, employee rosters and payment reports from the account's data.

skills.name: Search the Toolset
skills.description: Searches 270 tools across 18 toolsets by keyword and runs the right one, with read-only mode and toolset filtering.
